title: 第20章 唐敬这王八蛋真不是东西！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: S他不是胡诌，而是研究过后觉得最有可能的结果，否则没办法解释北狄这反常的举动。然而听到他的话，狄苍却笑了：“哟呵，小子，你还研究军事呢？”“想法是好的，不过，北狄是不可能和东虞联手的，你见过老虎需要联合麋鹿捕猎吗？”“大炎和东虞，都是人家桌上的菜！”炎文帝嘴角也有了笑容，道：“东虞现在内部矛盾重重，没时间和北狄掺和，而且，东虞刚刚和大炎签订互不侵犯条约。”“丞相赵桧回乡祭祖，其实暗地里就是为了和东虞签订这条约。”“所以，就像老将军说的，东虞和大炎，在北狄眼中都是菜！”“现在没开战，那是因为人家根本就不屑我们的防御。”老王爷看了唐逸一眼，皱眉道：“本王倒是觉得小唐说得有理，还是让东虞的暗谍查一下吧！”炎文帝和老将军相视一眼，笑着点头。年轻人能多想是好事，这个面子还是要给的嘛！唐逸挠了挠头，笑道：“都说了闲聊嘛，你们就别逮着我的话头不依不饶了。”话是这么说，但他依旧坚持自己的猜测。北狄陈兵边境，是为了策应东虞军队的行动。因为只要东虞军队出其不意攻下墉城关，就能将北境和京都分割开，到时候北境就是案板上的肉。如果他是将领，他就会这么做！打仗这玩意儿，就是打一个信息认知！老梁说东虞内部矛盾严重，没时间和北狄掺和，但他觉得恰好相反，解决内部矛盾的最好方式就是对外战争。曾经那畜生小日子就是这么干的！“好了，不聊那些糟心事了，聊聊一点私事。”狄苍靠过来，冲着唐逸挤眉弄眼：“小子，你不知道你那首《满江红》对那群文官造成多大的打击，现在想想他们的脸，老子都觉得解气。”“但那不太合老夫的心境，你再给老夫来一首，让老夫好好气气那群软骨头。”炎文帝端着茶杯，也笑着看向唐逸。今日他不买诗，就是因为狄苍要买。这老家伙在宫里，差点将他烦个半死，不然他会将这老家伙带来见唐逸？符合老将军心境的诗，还真有，辛弃疾的《破阵子》不就是吗？只是唐逸还没说话，唐音稚嫩的声音已经响起。“爷爷，先付钱！”“我哥哥说了，买诗可以，先付钱。”唐逸嘴角猛地抽搐了下，妹啊，那是因为当时咱们没有选择，怕被骗了。但现在咱面前的是两个皇族成员，一个威震天下的大将军，他们会赖账吗？而且，你哥有求大将军啊！“咳，老将军，童言无忌……”唐逸还想挽救下，老将军已经将五百两银子拍在他的手中：“哈哈，小姑娘说得对，先给钱，连你萧叔都没例外，老夫也不能例外。”“老家伙，愣着干嘛？笔墨伺候啊！”老将军直接冲着陈貂寺怒吼。很快，陈貂寺便找来了纸笔。“老将军，你是真连点拒绝的余地都不给我啊！”唐逸毛笔沾墨，挥笔边写边道：“老将军，话先说好啊，我要是写得不好，银子我就不要了。”“我要是写得好，我需要老将军帮我在将军府打造个训练场。”“我现在身体太虚，给自己打造了一套训练方式，但唐家场地有限，没办法放开练，将军府有点兵校场，借我折腾一段时间。”话说完，一首《破阵子·为狄老将军壮词以寄之》便写完了。“醉里挑灯看剑，梦回吹角连营。八百里分麾下炙，五十弦翻塞外声，沙场秋点兵。”“马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊。了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名，可怜白发生！”“呃，这诗好吗？”唐逸刚收笔，老将军便迫不及待抢过纸张，将词念了出来。他水平并不高，别看前两日早朝闹得贼凶，那特妈都是装出来的。所以他念完这一首诗，虽然鸡皮疙瘩都起来了，但还是说不出好不好，下意识求助看向炎文帝和老王爷。结果，却看到炎文帝手中的茶杯吧嗒一声掉在地上，老王爷手里的鸡翅膀也掉在地上了。好吧，确定了，这是一首好诗！“这词足以和满江红相媲美，便宜你这老匹夫了。”炎文帝有些吃味，特别是看到《破阵子·为狄老将军壮词以寄之》这几个大字，只觉得那是相当刺眼。先不说你狄苍算不算大炎名将，单凭这首词，你狄苍就足够名垂千古了。老王爷看向唐逸，指尖下意识颤抖起来，看得出来他此时也很意动，很想让唐逸也给自己写一首。但想想还是忍住了，万一写得没狄苍这首好，那这老东西尾巴不得翘上天了？“哈哈，这样我就放心了，老子等下要去状元街，老子要好好的气气那群老贼，哈哈哈……”狄苍抬手拍着唐逸的肩膀，大笑道：“小子，不就是建个训练场吗？你想建什么随便建，随你折腾！”唐逸连忙站起拱手道：“行，那就多谢老将军了。”“老将军，萧叔，老王爷，要没什么事，我先告辞了！”唐逸再度拱了拱手，带着唐音离开酒楼。只是临出酒楼，唐音挣脱唐逸的手，跑到炎文帝的身边跪了下来，恭恭敬敬行了一礼：“音儿还没给叔叔行礼，音儿拜见萧叔叔，萧叔叔好。”炎文帝一愣，随即哈哈大笑：“好个聪明的小丫头，这一声叔叔叫得我都不敢白接啊！”“女孩子给银子太俗气，那叔叔便送你一块玉佩吧！”炎文帝将唐音抱了起来，摘下腰间的玉佩，挂在了唐音的腰上。见到这一幕，老王爷，狄苍，陈貂寺等人脸色都变了。那是皇帝的随身玉佩，象征着皇族身份啊！陛下竟然就这样送给了唐音？但几人都不敢声张，不然会暴露炎文帝的身份。唐音没敢接，回头看向唐逸。唐逸嘴角也在轻微抽搐，他知道唐音单纯只是想给萧叔行个礼，毕竟之前给狄老将军和老王爷行了大礼，不能少了萧策。可问题是这么一搞，搞得像是他故意让妹妹去要好处一样！唐逸刚想开口拒绝，炎文帝冷哼一声道：“关他屁事，这是我送给音音的，音音不用管你哥，你喜欢就好。”唐音扭着小腰转了一圈，玉佩一晃一晃的，很好看咧。“谢谢萧叔叔。”行了礼，小丫头一蹦一跳回到唐逸的身边，牵着唐逸往外走。唐逸只能尴尬告退。看着唐逸牵着一蹦一跳的唐音离开的背影，炎文帝，老将军，老王爷三人脸上的笑容便渐渐敛了下去。“妈的，唐敬这王八蛋，真不是个东西，呸！”老将军往地面吐了口唾沫，满脸嫌弃。
content_en: S He is not making nonsense, but is the most likely result after research. Otherwise, there is no way to explain Beidi's abnormal behavior.However, after hearing his words, Di Cang smiled: "Oh, boy, are you still studying military affairs?" "The idea is good, but it is impossible for Beidi to join forces with Dongyu. Have you ever seen a tiger need to join forces with an elk to hunt?"Dayan and Dongyu are both food on the table!" Emperor Yanwen also smiled and said: "Dongyu is currently experiencing many internal conflicts and has no time to interfere with Beidi.Moreover, Dongyu has just signed a non-aggression treaty with Dayan.""Prime Minister Zhao Hui returned to his hometown to worship his ancestors, secretly to sign this treaty with Dongyu." "So, as the old general said, Dongyu and Dayan are both dishonest in Beidi's eyes!" "There is no war now, that's because theyThey don't care about our defense at all." The old prince glanced at Tang Yi and frowned: "I think Xiao Tang's words are reasonable.Let's let Dongyu's secret agents investigate!" Emperor Yanwen and the old general looked at each other and nodded with a smile.It's a good thing for young people to think more, and this face should be given to them!Tang Yi scratched his head and said with a smile: "We've already talked about small talk, so don't hold on to me for talking about it." That's what he said, but he still insisted on his guess.The Chen Bing border in Beidi was to coordinate the actions of the Dongyu army.Because as long as Dongyu's army captures Yongcheng Pass by surprise, it will be able to separate the northern border from Kyoto, and then the northern border will be meat on the chopping board.If he were a general, he would do this!Fighting this thing is to fight information cognition!Lao Liang said that Dongyu had serious internal conflicts and had no time to interfere with Beidi, but he felt that on the contrary, the best way to resolve internal conflicts was to engage in foreign war.That's what that beast did when he was little!"Okay, let's not talk about those bad things, let's talk about some personal matters." Di Cang leaned over and winked at Tang Yi: "Boy, you don't know how big a blow your song "Man Jiang Hong" had on those civil servants. Thinking about their faces now, I feel relieved." "But that doesn't suit my mood. You can play another song for me to make me angry at those weaklings." Emperor Yanwen held the teacup and looked at Tang Yi with a smile.He didn't buy poems today just because Di Cang wanted to buy them.This old guy was in the palace and almost annoyed him to death, otherwise he would bring this old guy to see Tang Yi?There really are poems that fit the old general's mood, isn't Xin Qiji's "Broken Array" that one?But before Tang Yi could speak, Tang Yin's childish voice had already sounded."Grandpa, pay first!" "My brother said, you can buy poems, but pay first." The corner of Tang Yi's mouth twitched suddenly, sister, that was because we had no choice at the time and were afraid of being cheated.But now we are facing two members of the royal family and a powerful general. Will they default on their debt?Moreover, your brother wants to be a general!"Ahem, old general, childlike words..." Tang Yi still wanted to save him, but the old general had already slapped five hundred taels of silver into his hand: "Haha, the little girl is right, give the money first, even your Uncle Xiao is no exception, and I am no exception." "Old guy, why are you standing there? You are waiting with pen and ink!" The old general roared directly at Chen Diao Si.Soon, Chen Diao Si found paper and pen."Old General, you really don't even give me any room to refuse!" Tang Yi dipped his brush in ink and wrote while writing: "Old General, let's talk first. If I don't write well, I won't give up the money." "If I write well, I need the old general to help me create a new one in the General's Mansion.Training ground." "I am too weak now, so I have created a training method for myself, but the Tang family's space is limited, so I can't practice it.The general's office has a military academy, let me work on it for a while." After saying this, I finished writing a poem "Broken Array: A Poem for Old General Di"."When I was drunk, I lit up the lamp to read the sword, and I dreamed of blowing the trumpet company. Eight hundred miles away, my subordinates were burning, fifty strings were heard outside the fortress, and the soldiers were ordered in autumn on the battlefield." "The horse moved so fast, and the bow was as frightened as the thunderbolt string. The king's affairs in the world were accomplished, and he won fame both before and after his life. Unfortunately, it happened in vain!" "Uh, is this poem good?" As soon as Tang Yi finished writing, the old general couldn't wait to grab the paper and read out the words.His level is not very high. Even though there was a lot of commotion in the mornings the past two days, it was all just an act.So after he read this poem, even though he had goosebumps, he still couldn't tell whether it was good or not. He subconsciously looked to Emperor Yanwen and the old prince for help.As a result, they saw the tea cup in Emperor Yanwen's hand falling to the ground with a clatter, and the chicken wings in the old prince's hand also fell to the ground.Okay, sure, this is a good poem!"This word is comparable to Manjianghong. It's cheap for an old man like you." Emperor Yan Wen was a little bit disgusted, especially when he saw the big words "Broken Zhenzi·A eloquent poem for Old General Di", he felt that it was quite dazzling.Let’s not talk about whether Di Cang is a famous general in Great Yan. This poem alone is enough to make you famous throughout the ages.The old prince looked at Tang Yi and his fingertips trembled subconsciously. It could be seen that he was also very moved at this time and wanted Tang Yi to write a song for him.But after thinking about it, I still held back. If the song I wrote was not as good as Di Cang's, then would this old guy have to keep his tail high?"Haha, I feel relieved. I'm going to Zhuangyuan Street later. I want to make those old thieves angry, hahaha..." Di Cang raised his hand and patted Tang Yi on the shoulder, laughing and said: "Boy, isn't it just to build a training ground? What do you want to build?Build it as you like!" Tang Yi quickly stood up and said, "Okay, thank you, old general." "Old general, Uncle Xiao, old prince, if nothing happens, I'll leave first!" Tang Yi cupped his hands again and left the restaurant with Tang Yin.Just before leaving the restaurant, Tang Yin broke away from Tang Yi's hand, ran to Emperor Yanwen, knelt down, and bowed respectfully: "Yin'er hasn't saluted uncle yet. Yin'er greets Uncle Xiao. Hello, Uncle Xiao." Emperor Yanwen was stunned, and then laughed: "What a smart little girl, I dare not accept this uncle’s call for nothing!“It’s too tacky for a girl to give you money, so uncle, I’ll give you a jade pendant!”Emperor Yan Wen picked up Tang Yin, took off the jade pendant from his waist, and hung it on Tang Yin’s waist.Seeing this scene, the faces of the old prince, Di Cang, Chen Diao Si and others changed.That is the emperor's jade pendant, which symbolizes the royal status!Your Majesty actually gave it to Tang Yin like this?But few people dared to speak out, otherwise the identity of Emperor Yanwen would be exposed.Tang Yin didn't dare to answer and looked back at Tang Yi.The corners of Tang Yi's mouth were also twitching slightly.
